findings.problem: One A/M/A-prime sequence did not itself prove the two independent reproductions required by ADR-0032.
findings.resolution: A reproduction runner now executes and verifies exactly two sequences, six distinct arms, identical source/image bindings, immutable packages and per-arm cleanup receipts.

findings.problem: A child process that failed before writing a package reference could be classified as DESIGN_REJECTED even when it emitted an explicit INFRA_ABORTED cause.
findings.resolution: Sequence and L1 wrapper boundaries now preserve explicit INFRA_ABORTED markers; unmarked instrumentation failures remain DESIGN_REJECTED.

findings.problem: The phrase 200-connection calibration could be misread as 200 total connections.
findings.resolution: D1 retains ADR-0032 semantics: 2,000 total real TLS PostgreSQL connections, maximum concurrency 200 and admission rate 50 per second.

findings.problem: PreflightSmoke was ordered after higher-load mainline diagnostics.
findings.resolution: After remediation merge, fresh smoke-20 is the sole PREFLIGHT_CHECK and is destroyed before 200, 500 and 1,000 non-acceptance diagnostics.

findings.problem: L1 produced three-window physical ledgers but had no two-run attribution reconciler, leaving category selection open to manual interpretation.
findings.resolution: The L1 attribution tool verifies two independent Measurement packages, their SHA256 and cleanup receipts, reconciles mutually exclusive physical deltas and selects only the next probe; it cannot authorize remediation.
